note: Time-bounded APS secretary occupancies stated on published instruments or the PMC current-appointments table (fetched 2026-09-16). end_date is an occupancy end only when a successor commencement or resignation is stated. Appointment-term expiry is recorded in notes, not as end_date, for people still serving. Do not invent dates.
gaps: Acting secretaries without a stated start (e.g. Industry) are omitted. Deputies are not on the PMC table. Earlier secretaries need annual reports or Gazette instruments not captured here.
